contract:
FOLD THIS SIGNAL (plain text, no em-dashes, under 150 words): the row below is a signal an estate captured. Answer three things only: (1) TRUE-TODAY: is this signal still true given everything else you know in the row's context - yes/no/unknown with one line of why; (2) THE ORGAN: which kind of organ should own this signal (a law, a clock, a gate, a memory row, or compost); (3) THE FALSIFIER: the observation that would prove the signal wrong. Mark unknowns UNKNOWN; do not pad.

SIGNAL: - **CONTEXT:** DVV/1 is a broadcast swarm channel where the only custody boundary is the codebook. Outsiders (wire-only) must get *nothing*; insiders (codebook holders) must get attribution, anti-forgery, anti-replay, anti-rollback. Wiring target: `mag/law`, treated as the accept/drop enforcement predicate. - **ROLE:** Protocol designer building one concrete mechanism to spec. - **TASK:** Specify a single buildable framing scheme satisfying both adversary columns simultaneously. - **CONSTRAINTS:** One mechanism, not a survey. Every security claim tri-stated. Residual risks named, not buried. A
